shortDescription: Viomi Technology NASDAQ:VIOT announced it has received a formal compliance letter from the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC, confirming the company has resolved its previous listing deficiency and fully satisfied Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(1).The notification closes a deficiency matter that began on July 2…

children: from the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC, confirming the company has resolved its previous listing deficiency and fully satisfied Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(1).

The notification closes a deficiency matter that began on July 23, 2026, when Nasdaq warned the company that its American Depositary Shares (ADSs) had traded below the required $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days.
According to the September 17 notice, Viomi's ADSs maintained a closing bid price of $1.00 or higher for 10 consecutive business days from September 2 through September 16, 2026.
Nasdaq confirmed that the company has regained full compliance and the matter is officially closed.

title: Viomi Technology regains compliance with Nasdaq minimum bid price rule
